page.overview:
What is Ruins of Alph?

The is a historical place located in the Johto region in the south-west of Violet City with entrances to the south of Route 36 and west of Route 32. It is a famed place for archaeologists who are researching the ruins to discover the mystery of the mysterious Pokémon called the Unown. The ruins are filled with Unown once any of the four slide puzzles inside have been activated.

In the Ruins of Alph, there are four puzzles that are considered to be the keys to enter the dimension of the Unown in the same room as where there are no puzzles. Those four puzzles contain a historical Pokémon or a Legendary Pokémon. The puzzles that appear in Pokémon Gold, Silver and Crystal are really different than the puzzles that are introduced in the renewal version of Pokémon Gold Version and Pokémon Silver Version; Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver.

{|style="margin:auto; width:310px; padding:2px; border:2px solid #FFD700; background-color:#BFC1C2; color:#000; text-align:center; " cellspacing=1 !Kabuto !Aerodactyl !Ho-Oh !Omanyte

Kabuto is actually the first puzzle that you will encounter in the Ruins of Alph, actually, each of the four puzzles can be the first puzzle that you can solve. The puzzle of Kabuto is also the easiest puzzle that you can solve. To get access to the first puzzle, you must enter the cave that is very close to the entrance of the Ruins of Alph which is just above the Research Center if you come from another entrance. Once entered, on the right side you will read the description of the puzzle containing to be: "A Pokémon that hid on the sea floor. Eyes on its back scanned the area".
